paragraphs: ITO Health is a Public Benefit Company built by clinicians and health professionals. It makes tools that help care workers and benefits specialists connect people to the support they need. The customers are health and social care organizations running the workflows behind eligibility decisions, enrollment, and ongoing coordination.

HealthBase and HealthWorks are the core offerings, sibling configurations of the same platform for different operational needs. HealthBase turns client information into completed benefit applications and real-world actions rather than referrals. HealthWorks is the employer-facing version, a benefit navigation platform for workforces. Eligibility decision support applies deterministic logic across more than 120 federal, state, and local programs to produce auditable determinations.

HealthBase is built for social service organizations, federally qualified health centers, community health centers, and healthcare systems that coordinate benefits enrollment and social care. The products page puts current eligibility and enrollment coverage at more than 75 federal and local programs. The platform supports HL7 FHIR, custom API integrations, and connections to electronic health records. The company states that it is a HIPAA-compliant organization. It says clinicians founded it.
